kind: function
name: hd_black_litterman
exported: true
signature: hd_black_litterman(sigma,w_mkt,P             = NULL,Q             = NULL,tau           = 0.05,omega         = NULL,risk_aversion = NULL)
arguments:
  P: Optional k × p numeric pick matrix encoding k investor views over p assets.
  Q: Numeric vector of length k — the expected return for each view portfolio in the same units as sigma (typically annualised decimals, e.g.
  omega: Optional k × k positive-definite matrix of view uncertainties.
  risk_aversion: Positive scalar — the market risk-aversion coefficient λ, used to compute the equilibrium prior Π = λ·Σ·w.
  sigma: A p × p numeric, positive-definite covariance matrix (asset names preserved as dimnames).
  tau: Positive scalar — the scalar controlling the uncertainty of the prior distribution.
  w_mkt: Named numeric vector of p market-cap weights that sum to approximately 1 (tolerance 0.01).
returns: 'A named list with the following components: Named numeric vector of length p — the Black-Litterman posterior expected returns.'

kind: function
name: hd_rolling_sharpe
exported: true
signature: hd_rolling_sharpe(r, w, ann_factor = 252)
arguments:
  ann_factor: Annualisation factor matching the frequency of r (252 for daily, 12 for monthly, 4 for quarterly).
  r: Numeric vector of period returns (daily, monthly, etc.).
  w: Integer window length in periods.
returns: Numeric vector of length max(0L, length(r_clean) - w + 1L) where r_clean = r[!is.na(r)].
---
kind: function
name: hd_sharpe_stability_ratio
exported: true
signature: hd_sharpe_stability_ratio(r, w, ann_factor = 252, lag_nw = NULL)
arguments:
  ann_factor: Annualisation factor (252 daily, 12 monthly).
  lag_nw: Newey-West bandwidth (number of lags).
  r: Numeric vector of period returns.
  w: Window length in periods.
returns: 'Named list with components: Sharpe Stability Ratio.'
---
kind: function
name: hd_top5pct_share
exported: true
signature: hd_top5pct_share(r, pct = 0.05)
arguments:
  pct: numeric in (0, 1).
  r: numeric vector of period returns (sign and magnitude both matter).
returns: 'named list with components: sum of top-pct returns / sum of all returns.'
---
kind: function
name: hd_crps_empirical
exported: true
signature: hd_crps_empirical(observed, forecast_samples, max_samples = 1000L)
arguments:
  forecast_samples: Numeric vector of simulated values from the predictive distribution.
  max_samples: Integer.
  observed: Scalar numeric.
returns: Scalar numeric CRPS value (non-negative).
---
kind: function
name: hd_crps_normal
exported: true
signature: hd_crps_normal(observed, mu, sigma)
arguments:
  mu: Scalar numeric.
  observed: Scalar numeric.
  sigma: Scalar numeric.
returns: Scalar numeric CRPS value (non-negative).
---
kind: function
name: hd_crps_skill
exported: true
signature: hd_crps_skill(crps_model, crps_naive)
arguments:
  crps_model: Numeric scalar or vector.
  crps_naive: Numeric scalar or vector.
returns: Scalar numeric skill score.
---
kind: function
name: hd_brier_score
exported: true
signature: hd_brier_score(observed_binary, forecast_prob)
arguments:
  forecast_prob: Numeric vector of probabilities in the unit interval.
  observed_binary: Integer or numeric vector of binary outcomes (0 or 1).
returns: Scalar numeric Brier score (range 0 to 1).
---
kind: function
name: hd_horizon_skill
exported: true
signature: hd_horizon_skill(returns, signal,horizons = 1:10,ann_factor = 252L)
arguments:
  ann_factor: Integer.
  horizons: Integer vector of forecast horizons in periods.
  returns: Numeric vector of period returns (e.g., daily), ordered chronologically.
  signal: Numeric vector of the same length as returns, representing the forecast signal at each time point.
returns: 'A [tibble:tibble]tibble with columns: Forecast horizon (integer).'
---
kind: function
name: hd_unreliable_volume_ticker
exported: true
signature: hd_unreliable_volume_ticker(ticker)
arguments:
  ticker: Character vector of ticker symbols.
returns: Logical vector, same length as ticker.
